## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d5b176c1747475ccf70cf6eb197076867a0a64fd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md + packages/services/service-messaging/src/push-channel.ts (`recipientLocale`, `pushNoticeLine`, `PUSH_NOTICE_LINES`), packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-locale.ts (`resolveRecipientLocale`), packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts (the push channel's `getData` / `getDefaultTemplateLocale` wiring), packages/spec/src/api/push-relay.zod.ts (the `text` describe), packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts (`locale`), the symbol anchors the amended bullet cites (relay.ts, push-plugin.ts, cloud-binding.ts, cloud-binding-service.ts, push-config.zod.ts), scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs and scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs (the anchor grammar), scripts/adr-index.mjs and docs/adr/README.md (the generated index), scripts/adr-anchors/README.md, and the git history of 97e42498 on origin/main.

Inputs: card #30670 (body, triage 6671694325, seat note 6674101046, claims 6677593204 / 6677637508, dev report 6678015079), ruling Q4 C item 6 in the Ruling-confirmed comment 6670237128 on #29920 (with its correction 6670407970 and the file-surface widening 6673499048 on PR #30749), PR #30834 body, labels and file list (one file, +3/-3), the diff `origin/main...pr30834`, and the check-runs on the head. Governed (rules) face: `docs/adr/**`. Nothing was built, run or re-run locally.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The privacy bullet's new wording is true of the code on `main`.** The hosted relay's generic line is chosen in `push-channel.ts`: `recipientLocale()` reads the recipient's `sys_user.locale` (`USER_OBJECT` / `RECIPIENT_LOCALE_FIELD`, a system-context `findOne` per delivery) and hands it to `resolveRecipientLocale(own, deploymentLocale)` with `deploymentLocale = opts.getDefaultTemplateLocale()`, which `messaging-service-plugin.ts` L544 wires to `II18nService.getDefaultLocale()`; `resolveRecipientLocale` returns the recipient's own normalised tag, else the deployment default. `pushNoticeLine(locale)` then takes that locale's line from `PUSH_NOTICE_LINES`, else its language's, else English. So "in the recipient's language (`sys_user.locale`, then the deployment default)" is the chain the code runs — RIGHT — and the example "You have a new notification" is the English row. English applies when neither is set (`pushNoticeLine(undefined)` returns `PUSH_NOTICE_LINES.en`) and also when the resolved locale has no line (an unknown tag falls to its language, then to English). The spec's `text` describe (push-relay.zod.ts L101) already says "in the recipient's language", so the ADR and the wire contract now agree. The line is chosen by the sender; the relay treats the payload as opaque, as the same bullet says, so the choice is correctly placed on this side of the wire.
- **The replaced wording is quoted, in PR #30749's own form.** The bullet ends with an italic note `Amended (date) (#30670, ruling Q4 C on #29920): the generic line's language read "in the device locale"` — the shape of the three #30749 notes at L310, L379 and L391 (italic, date, card and ruling in parentheses, the old wording quoted). The Status line gains one `Amended (date, #30670, on ruling Q4 C of #29920)` clause after "ADR-0030 is unchanged.", separated by the same middle dot as the earlier clauses, naming both edits and the wording each replaces — RIGHT. After the change the only "device locale" occurrences in the file are the two quotations of the retired wording, as the PR's two-minute check says.
- **The 97e42498 pin is a true reading of the bullet.** 97e42498 is the squash-merge of PR #30749 on origin/main (single parent d996c381, an ancestor of `main`), the commit that landed both the relay sender and the bullet's current text; between 97e42498 and the PR's base no commit touches `packages/services/service-push/**`, `push-channel.ts`, `messaging-service-plugin.ts`, `cloud-binding.ts`, `cloud-binding-service.ts`, `push-relay.zod.ts` or the ADR, so the bullet's reading taken at 97e42498 is the reading at the base as well. Its date in the heading is the commit's own date. Every symbol anchor the bullet cites resolves on the PR tree (`RelayPushSender`, `PUSH_RELAY_PATH`, `createCloudBinding`, `ICloudBindingService`, `PUSH_RELAY_AIR_GAPPED_MESSAGE`, `PushRelayPayloadSchema`, `PushRelayTransportConfigSchema` — each with a declaration site in its file) and push-relay.zod.ts carries no `PLANNED` marker, as the bullet claims. The restored pin has the form of the heading PR #30749 replaced ("at 6a4737ab" with its date), which that PR's record quotes — RIGHT, and it closes should-fix 1 of delta review 6674074177 as seat note 6674101046 asked.
- **`check:adr-symbol-anchors` holds on this diff.** The anchor grammar admits three code-span forms (`dir/file.ts#symbol`, `dir/file.ts`, cross-repo) and declares a line number not an anchor. The diff adds no code-span path, no line citation and no new symbol; a commit sha in running prose is not path-shaped and the replaced heading carried the same shape on the tree the gate passed. The anchors on the three touched lines are unchanged and resolve (above). The dev reports the gate in the derived set at exit 0 on d5b176c1; the CI job that carries it was still in progress at this read.
- **No `scripts/adr-anchors/` row is owed.** The README's rule is an anchor where an ADR's decision is realised in code that would look arbitrary; this diff is prose and touches no code, and the code the wording describes already carries the ruling's id in `push-channel.ts`'s docblock ("ruling on #29920 Q4 C").
- **The generated index is unaffected.** `docs/adr/README.md` is generated from the Status line by `scripts/adr-index.mjs`, keyed on the first keyword (`Draft`) and truncated well before the appended clause; the ADR-0012 row on the PR tree is byte-identical to `main`'s, so leaving the README untouched is correct.

### ② Semver level

None, correctly: one `docs/adr/**` file, no package touched, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, and the `skip-changeset` label — the label's one legitimate use, a diff that touches no publishable package (`Check Changeset` is `success`). No changeset, no dogfood battery.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report: no open questions, no deviations, no out-of-scope findings — consistent with the diff: one file, three lines, exactly the surface the claim named (§6.1 privacy bullet, the "What `main` serves" heading, the Status line; no `packages/**`, no `scripts/adr-anchors/**`).
- Seat note 6674101046 (restore a tree pin on the "What `main` serves" heading, naming the commit the new reading was taken against) — EXECUTED, and the acceptance note's choice of the merge commit 97e42498 over the branch base 2038c56e is the right one: it is the tree the bullet's text and the code it describes both landed in, and nothing on the cited paths moved after it (verified above).
- Ruling Q4 C item 6 — the ADR half is exactly what this PR does; the code half shipped in PR #30749 (`resolveRecipientLocale`, the describe at push-relay.zod.ts L101). The card's premise (re-read §6.1 on `main` after #30749 merged) holds: the branch is off 2038c56e, after 97e42498.
- Tier H: `docs/adr/**` is on the governed register at Tier H. This record is the contract-tier review the schema/rules face owes; it does not lift Tier H — the landing needs an authorized APPROVED review by a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account or the maintainer's own merge, and no seat arms, queues or un-drafts it before that (the PR body says so).
- Code location note: the brief named `relay.ts` as the place the line's language is chosen; on `main` it is `push-channel.ts` in service-messaging (`pushNoticeLine`, called at L230 per delivery), and relay.ts only carries the `text` the channel hands it. The ADR names neither file for this rule, so nothing in the diff is wrong about it.

### ④ Design judgment

**docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md** — HOLDS against the code it describes (the recipient-locale chain and the notice-line table in push-channel.ts; the `text` describe in push-relay.zod.ts), against the ruling it implements (Q4 C item 6, "`resolveRecipientLocale` (`sys_user.locale` → deployment default), English when absent"), and against its first consumers (a reader of §6.1 deciding what a device shows; the cloud-side relay implementer reading the wire contract, for whom nothing changes — the relay stays opaque to `text`). The amendment follows the ADR's own convention as PR #30749 wrote it: the Status line is the single fact and gains one dated clause; each amended passage quotes the wording it replaces; the tree pin names the commit the reading was taken against. Tried to break it: (a) does the pin over-claim? No — the bullet's every cited symbol resolves and no later commit touched the cited paths. (b) Does the new wording claim a locale that is not read? No — `sys_user.locale` exists (sys-user.object.ts L1193) and is the field `RECIPIENT_LOCALE_FIELD` names. (c) Does it contradict §6.1's wire bullet or the relay's opacity? No. One omission, below.

Findings:

- should-fix 1 (docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md §6.1): the parenthesis states the locale chain and stops; the ruling's sentence has a third step, "English when absent", which the code runs twice over (no locale resolved, or a resolved locale with no line in `PUSH_NOTICE_LINES`). The example line is the English one, so a reader can infer it, but the ADR is the durable record of the ruling and should state the fallback: "(`sys_user.locale`, then the deployment default, else English)". A one-word amendment; it can ride the next ADR-0012 amendment rather than cost a Tier H merge of its own, at the maintainer's choice.

No must-fix.

Check-runs on head d5b176c1 at the time of this read: none red; `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Plan Test Core shards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · scoped · query-options erasure`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` and `Type Check · source gates` are `success`; `Test Core (1/8)`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` were still `in_progress`. This record judges the diff; the seat's ACCEPT and the Tier H approver read the finished conclusions.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ad196da4977502b94c282c1cdc07988a66579329`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md + packages/services/service-messaging/src/push-channel.ts (`pushNoticeLine`, `PUSH_NOTICE_LINES`) and packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-locale.ts (`resolveRecipientLocale`), the code the amended sentence describes.

Delta record: one commit ad196da4 on top of d5b176c1 (one file, +2/-2), judged against the tree. The PASS of record 6678095806 on d5b176c1 is carried forward for everything this commit did not touch: the "What `main` serves" heading and its 97e42498 pin, the italic amendment note, the Status line's other clauses, and every symbol anchor are byte-identical between the two heads. Nothing was built, run or re-run locally.

### ① Derived judgments

- The word-level diff is exactly two insertions and nothing else: `default)` becomes `default, else English)` in §6.1's privacy bullet and in the Status line's `Amended (…, #30670, …)` clause, so both now read "in the recipient's language (`sys_user.locale`, then the deployment default, else English)" — RIGHT, and true of `main`: `resolveRecipientLocale` returns the recipient's own tag, else the deployment default, and `pushNoticeLine` takes that locale's row of `PUSH_NOTICE_LINES`, else its language's, else `PUSH_NOTICE_LINES.en`; with neither locale set it returns the English row. The sentence now states the whole rule the ruling recorded (Q4 C item 6: "`sys_user.locale` → deployment default, English when absent").
- The amendment convention is unchanged: the Status clause and the bullet move together, the replaced wording "in the device locale" is still quoted in exactly its two places, no new clause or note is added for a change to text this same card introduced.
- No anchor, path or line citation is added or moved; the seven code-span anchors on the touched lines are the ones d5b176c1 carried and resolve as before. `check:adr-symbol-anchors` is unaffected; `docs/adr/README.md` stays untouched and correct (the index keys on the Status keyword and truncates before the clause).

### ② Semver level

None, unchanged: `docs/adr/**` only, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The delta adopts should-fix 1 of record 6678095806 verbatim and touches nothing else — HOLDS. No open questions, no deviations.
- Tier H stands as before: this record is the contract-tier review; the landing still needs a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval or the maintainer's own merge.

### ④ Design judgment

**docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md** — HOLDS against the code it describes, the ruling it implements and its readers; the one omission the first record named is closed, and the sentence can no longer be read as leaving an unset-locale recipient without a line. No finding.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

This record judges the diff; the seat's ACCEPT and the Tier H approver read the finished conclusions.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT

PR #30834 · head `ad196da4` · 2026-11-06T06:04Z · card #30670 under ruling Q4 C of #29920 (item 6) · claim re-posted with Branch `claude/project-thread-r8swte` · os-dev report 6678015079 · contract review PASS 6678095806 (`d5b176c1`) and delta PASS 6678247372 (`ad196da4`)

## 维护者速读（席位校正）

- 改了什么：ADR-0012 §6.1 隐私条把中继通用提示语的语言从「设备语言」改为「收件人的语言（`sys_user.locale`，其次部署默认，再无则英文）」；状态行加一条修订记录；「What `main` serves」条重新标明它所依据的代码版本（97e42498，即 PR #30749 的合并提交）。
- 为什么改：按 #29920 Q4 C 裁决，PR #30749 实际按收件人语言选这句提示语，ADR 原文与实现不一致；树钉是 PR #30749 契约复核 should-fix 1 留下的尾巴。
- 风险与回滚：纯 ADR 文字，一个文件，无代码、无行为改动；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md` 的 §6.1 隐私条（Privacy 那一条）和 Status 行末尾新增的 Amended 段。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "device locale" docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md`，预期只剩修订记录里引用旧措辞的两处。
- 需要你做的：`docs/adr/**` 属 Tier H，需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS（os-zhuang / hotlong）批准，或你本人合并。依据：契约复核 PASS 6678095806 与增量复核 PASS 6678247372，Head-sha `ad196da4`。

Seat opinion: the body's lines stand except the first, which predates the adopted should-fix ("…其次部署默认" is now "…其次部署默认，再无则英文"); the lines above are the corrected six.

## 席位核对

- **Ruling fit:** the wording is true of `main`. `push-channel.ts` reads `sys_user.locale`, `resolveRecipientLocale` falls back to the deployment default, and `pushNoticeLine` falls back to English, which is the full Q4 C item 6 rule. It now agrees with the `text` describe in `push-relay.zod.ts`.
- **Convention:** one dated Amended clause on the Status line, and an italic end-of-bullet note quoting the replaced wording, the same shape PR #30749 used. The 97e42498 pin is the PR #30749 merge on `main`, and every anchor in the bullet resolves.
- **Review:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, by an agent other than the drafter. The one should-fix ("else English") was adopted at `ad196da4`; the delta has no finding.
- **Declarations:** `Fixes #30670`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset` (docs/adr only).
- **Gates (report, `ad196da4`):** 21 derived, 21 exit 0, `--ran` 21/21, 0 NOT-MEASURED; `check:adr-symbol-anchors` and `check:cli-command-ids` 0. No `scripts/adr-anchors/` row is owed.
- **Landing:** Tier H (`docs/adr/**`). After a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` APPROVED review, or the maintainer's own merge, the seat runs the pre-landing checks and lands it with `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`. Until then the PR stays draft, labelled `pm:awaiting-merge`.
